keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «티라노사우루스가 둘을 향해 달려오고 있었다(문제)» 와 «때로는 가장 순한 친구가 가장 용감한 친구이기도 하다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (a T. rex was running toward them) and the lesson (sometimes the gentlest friend is also the bravest). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Jae, his sister Ara, a long-necked dinosaur
A T. rex ran toward Jae and Ara.
The gentlest friend can also be the bravest.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

into the jungle. When a T. rex ran at them, they had nowhere to
. The gentle dinosaur swung its huge

words: A storm pushed Jae and his sister Ara's boat to a strange island.
land with water all around it
Suddenly, they heard a loud roar behind them.
a very loud, deep sound that an animal makes
moved something in a big curve
Sometimes the gentlest friend is also the bravest.

qs.q: Why did the T. rex run away?
opts: The long-necked dinosaur swung its huge tail.
The storm came back and scared it.
evs: It swung its huge tail, and the T. rex ran away.
A storm pushed Jae and his sister Ara's boat to a strange island.
It was calm and gentle, so they followed it into the jungle.
It carried them back to their boat on the beach.
why: 목이 긴 공룡이 커다란 꼬리를 휘두르자 티라노는 도망갔어요. 폭풍이 다시 왔다거나 아이들이 소리쳤다는 말은 없어요.
The long-necked dinosaur swung its huge tail, and the T. rex ran away. Nothing says the storm came back or that the children shouted.

qs.q: The story says, "The gentle giant lowered its head." Who is "the gentle giant"?
qs.qko: "The gentle giant lowered its head."라는 문장이 있어요. 여기서 "the gentle giant"는 누구인가요?
evs: It was calm and gentle, so they followed it into the jungle.
A T. rex was running toward them!
The trees were taller than buildings, and the ground shook with heavy steps.
why: 앞에서 목이 긴 공룡이 «얌전하고 순했다»고 했어요. 나무 꼭대기의 잎을 먹을 만큼 아주 큰 공룡이니, "순한 거인"은 바로 목이 긴 공룡이에요.
Earlier, the long-necked dinosaur was «calm and gentle». It is huge, big enough to eat leaves from the top of a tree, so "the gentle giant" is the long-necked dinosaur.

qs.q: Why is the long-necked dinosaur both the gentlest and the bravest?
qs.qko: 목이 긴 공룡은 왜 가장 순하면서도 가장 용감하다고 할 수 있나요?
opts: It was calm and gentle, but it stepped in front of the T. rex to save the children.
It was the biggest animal on the island.
It ran away faster than the T. rex.
evs: It was calm and gentle, so they followed it into the jungle.
They ran, but there was nowhere to hide.
Then the long-necked dinosaur stepped between them and the T. rex.
It carried them back to their boat on the beach.
why: 공룡은 얌전하고 순했지만, 아이들과 티라노 사이를 막아서서 아이들을 지켰어요. 두 문장을 이으면 순하면서도 용감하다는 답이 나와요.
The dinosaur was calm and gentle, but it stepped between the children and the T. rex to protect them. Put these two sentences together to find the answer.

ends: Jae and Ara come back with fruit for their gentle friend.
재와 아라가 순한 공룡 친구에게 줄 과일을 들고 다시 찾아가요.
Jae and Ara find a big dinosaur egg on the beach.
재와 아라가 바닷가에서 커다란 공룡 알을 발견해요.

write.src: “Let’s <u>be kind to gentle animals</u> so that <u>they can trust us</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «함께 할 일 + 그 목적» 으로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write something to do together and its purpose in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «Let’s» 뒤에는 동사(be, help)를 바로 쓰고, «so that» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을 할 수 있다» 를 쓰세요.
write.moreEn: One more step: after «Let’s», write a verb (be, help). After «so that», write who + what they can do.

img.cover: In a giant green jungle, a huge long-necked dinosaur with green skin, light yellow spots and kind brown eyes stands bravely in front of a nine-year-old Korean boy with short spiky black hair, an orange T-shirt and blue shorts and his older sister, a twelve-year-old Korean girl with a long black braid, a yellow T-shirt and green shorts, swinging its long tail toward a brown T. rex that turns around and runs away.

scenes.1: In a jungle with trees taller than buildings, a nine-year-old Korean boy with short spiky black hair, an orange T-shirt and blue shorts and his older sister, a twelve-year-old Korean girl with a long black braid, a yellow T-shirt and green shorts peek out from behind giant ferns at a huge long-necked dinosaur with green skin, light yellow spots and kind brown eyes, who is calmly eating leaves from the top of a very tall tree.
scenes.3: On a sunny beach, a huge long-necked dinosaur with green skin, light yellow spots and kind brown eyes lowers its long neck next to a small wooden boat, while a nine-year-old Korean boy with short spiky black hair, an orange T-shirt and blue shorts and his older sister, a twelve-year-old Korean girl with a long black braid, a yellow T-shirt and green shorts slide down from its neck, laughing happily.

alt.1: Two children peek at a long-necked dinosaur eating leaves.
alt.3: The dinosaur brings the children back to their boat on the beach.
